snippet.title: In Vino Veritas - Official Trailer | Psychological Horror Game (Free Demo Out Now)
snippet.description:
In Vino Veritas is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a 
desecrated cathedral. Drink from the chalice. See what the wine wants you to see.

▶ PLAY THE FREE DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4588720/
▶ WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348190/

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT THE GAME

Inspired by a forbidden theory proposed by an official Bible translator, the 
Hebrew word "Elohim" - translated as "God" - is grammatically plural. In the 
original scriptures there is no single God, but multiple entities: ancient, 
warlike, and inhuman.

After a devastating battle, the Elohim abandoned our world, vowing to return.
Not all of them left.

One renegade Elohim remained, hiding within the shadows of a cathedral, 
patiently shaping a prophecy. Its purpose is not salvation. 

Your wife vanished during an investigation inside that cathedral. The wine, 
made from the blood of an Elohim, is the only thing that will show you where 
she went.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

- First-person atmospheric horror - no combat, no chase sequences
- Explore a desecrated cathedral and its hidden foundations
- Environmental puzzles built to keep a horrifying creature from finding 
  the Elohim
- Each chalice you drink from reveals another fragment of the truth
- Story-rich, lore-driven mystery rooted in real translation scholarship
- Built in Unreal Engine 5

For players who love slow-burn, atmosphere-first horror in the vein of 
Amnesia, SOMA and Layers of Fear.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LINKS

Steam (wishlist): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348190/
Steam (free demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4588720/
Discord: https://discord.gg/zb3VVh87tq
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lessonnotlearned_games/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@lessonnotlearnedgames

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Developed and published by Lesson Not Learned Games.
Release: 2027 — PC (Steam). English full audio, Italian subtitles.

Content notice: mature themes, non-graphic realistic violence, religious 
fanaticism, and a narrative reference to suicide.


Full disclosure is available on the Steam store page.
